claims.text: Source-29 states that it resolves RWY Conjecture 4.10 and proves minimality of \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]

Source-29 describes the transposed generating set and says its minimality could be proved by transposing the arguments; this passage is not itself a theorem proving it. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-841]
